verdict.rationale:
The docs mention remote identity verification via eID or video (doc-16), which is a form of stronger signer identity check, but there is no evidence of configurable verification tiers (SMS OTP, ID check, knowledge-based authentication) that a legal-ops lead could selectively require per sensitive document.

missing for 10: per-document configurable verification levels (SMS, KBA), explicit ID-check workflow documentation, admin controls to enforce stronger verification on specific documents.
